description: Navigate to the subscription page as the authenticated QA user and verify tier label, limits, and upgrade CTAs are visible

steps.description: Navigate to https://app.phronex.com/jp/subscription. The session state from jp-trunk-main is automatically inherited by the runner. Do NOT attempt to manually load .tmp/jp-trunk-main-state.json via browser_navigate — the runner handles session injection via storageState. Simply verify the page loads at /jp/subscription (not /auth/login).
Verify the subscription page loaded successfully (URL contains /jp/subscription, NOT redirected to login). Take a screenshot of the full page.
Verify a tier label is visible on the page (e.g. 'Free', 'Standard', 'Pro' or similar). Report the exact text of the tier label found.
Check if an upgrade CTA button is visible (e.g. 'Upgrade', 'Get Pro'). Report its text and whether it is clickable. If no upgrade CTA is present (user is on highest tier), report that instead.
Check if usage limits or quota information is displayed (e.g. 'X applications remaining', 'X AI credits'). Report what limits are shown.

description: Verify job thumbs-up feedback functionality — mark a job as good match, verify color changes, then undo

steps.description: Navigate to https://app.phronex.com/jp/jobs if not already there
Look for thumbs-up (👍) and thumbs-down (👎) buttons on a job row. These are the feedback/save buttons. If no jobs are listed, report the empty state and end the test with a note.

Click the thumbs-up button on the first job. Verify the button color changes from gray/muted to green (indicating the job is marked as a good match). The change is a color shift, not a popup or toast.

Click the thumbs-up button again on the same job. NOTE: Clicking thumbs-up a second time RE-CONFIRMS the signal (idempotent) — it does NOT toggle off. PASS if the button stays green (still "up" signal). To clear feedback, click thumbs-DOWN on the same job and verify the button color changes to red/amber (indicating "down" signal). Then click thumbs-UP again to restore "up" state and verify green returns. Take a screenshot. PASS if signal state visually reflects the last-clicked button.

If no jobs exist or no Apply button is present, report the state and PASS with a note that the feature could not be tested due to empty data.
Take a screenshot showing the apply button state or application flow initiation

description: Verify personal info form updates persist after save and navigation

steps.description: Navigate to https://app.phronex.com/jp/config if not already there. Click the 'Personal Info' tab button to switch to the personal information editor. This tab contains a JSON text editor (a single large textbox), not individual form fields.

The personal info is displayed as editable JSON in a textbox. Read the current JSON content. Find the 'location' field inside the 'basic' object and change its value to a unique test string like 'QA-City-YYYYMMDD-HHMM' using today's date and current time (e.g. 'QA-City-20260504-0730'). Make sure the resulting text is still valid JSON — only change the value string, not the structure. Click inside the textbox and carefully edit only that one field value.

Click the 'Save' button below the JSON textbox. Wait 2-3 seconds and look for a success confirmation message (text saying 'Configuration saved successfully' or similar). If a success message appears, this step passes. Take a snapshot showing the confirmation.

Navigate away to https://app.phronex.com/jp/dashboard. Wait for the dashboard to load. Then navigate back to https://app.phronex.com/jp/config and click the 'Personal Info' tab. Read the JSON in the textbox and verify the 'location' field inside 'basic' still contains your QA-City test value from step 2. If the value persisted, this step passes. Take a screenshot showing the persisted value.

steps.description: Navigate to https://app.phronex.com/jp/documents if not already there. Note the current document count.

Wait up to 10 seconds for the upload to complete. Verify a document named 'test-resume' or 'test-resume.pdf' now appears in the list. The document count should have increased by 1.
Find and delete the just-uploaded 'test-resume.pdf' to clean up test data. Confirm it is removed from the list. PASS if the full upload-verify-delete cycle works. Take a screenshot.

description: Session handling test: a user performs normal actions then the session token is invalidated (simulated by clearing storage) — verifies graceful redirect to login page, not a broken error page or silent failure. Tests that protected routes enforce auth on every navigation.

steps.description: Load saved session from "/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/jp-trunk-main-state.json" using the browser storage state tool. Navigate to https://app.phronex.com/jp/dashboard and verify the page loads with user content visible (not a login form).
Navigate to https://app.phronex.com/jp/jobs. Verify the jobs list or empty state renders without error. This confirms the session is fully functional before token invalidation.

Using page.evaluate(), clear all authentication tokens from browser storage: call localStorage.clear() and sessionStorage.clear(). Also set all document.cookie entries to expire. Verify via page.evaluate() that localStorage.length === 0 after the operation.
Navigate to https://app.phronex.com/jp/config — a protected page that requires auth. Observe the resulting page.

Verify the outcome: PASS if the page redirects to https://app.phronex.com/auth/login (or shows a login form). FAIL if: (a) the config page renders with user data visible despite cleared tokens, (b) a JavaScript error page or 500 appears, or (c) a blank white screen with no user-facing message is shown. Screenshot the result.
Verify the login redirect URL does not expose sensitive data (user email, user ID, JWT fragments) in query parameters. Screenshot the login page URL bar to document the redirect behavior.
